1: // Simple "Orbit Escape" game targeting <canvas id="game"></canvas>
2: // Ship: rotates with ArrowLeft/ArrowRight, thrusts with ArrowUp, consumes fuel.
3: // Asteroids: rotating circles moving left‑to‑right, wrapping around.
4: // Fuel cells: small circles collected to restore fuel.
5: // Lose when ship hits an asteroid or runs out of fuel.
6: 
7: (() => {
8:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
9:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas with id="game" not found');
10:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
11:   // Set canvas size to match its displayed size
12:   const resize = () => {
13:     canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
14:     canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
15:   };
16:   resize();
17:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
18: 
19:   // ----- Game state -------------------------------------------------------
20:   const ship = {
21:     x: canvas.width / 2,
22:     y: canvas.height / 2,
23:     angle: 0, // radians, 0 points up
24:     radius: 10,
25:     vx: 0,
26:     vy: 0,
27:     thrust: 0.1,
28:     rotSpeed: 0.06,
29:     fuel: 100,
30:     maxFuel: 100,
31:   };
32: 
33:   const asteroids = [];
34:   const fuels = [];
35:   const maxAsteroids = 8;
36:   const maxFuels = 3;
37: 
38:   const rand = (min, max) => Math.random() * (max - min) + min;
39: 
40:   const addAsteroid = () => {
41:     const radius = rand(15, 35);
42:     const y = rand(radius, canvas.height - radius);
43:     const speed = rand(0.5, 2);
44:     const angle = rand(0, Math.PI * 2);
45:     const rot = rand(-0.03, 0.03);
46:     asteroids.push({ x: -radius, y, radius, speed, angle, rot });
47:   };
48: 
49:   const addFuelCell = () => {
50:     const radius = 8;
51:     const x = rand(radius, canvas.width - radius);
52:     const y = rand(radius, canvas.height - radius);
53:     fuels.push({ x, y, radius, value: 30 });
54:   };
55: 
56:   // initialise objects
57:   for (let i = 0; i < maxAsteroids; i++) addAsteroid();
58:   for (let i = 0; i < maxFuels; i++) addFuelCell();
59: 
60:   // ----- Input handling ----------------------------------------------------
61:   const keys = {};
62:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.code] = true));
63:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.code] = false));
64: 
65:   // ----- Helper functions -------------------------------------------------
66:   const wrap = (obj) => {
67:     if (obj.x < -obj.radius) obj.x = canvas.width + obj.radius;
68:     if (obj.x > canvas.width + obj.radius) obj.x = -obj.radius;
69:     if (obj.y < -obj.radius) obj.y = canvas.height + obj.radius;
70:     if (obj.y > canvas.height + obj.radius) obj.y = -obj.radius;
71:   };
72: 
73:   const dist = (x1, y1, x2, y2) => Math.hypot(x2 - x1, y2 - y1);
74: 
75:   // ----- Game loop --------------------------------------------------------
76:   let gameOver = false;
77:   const loop = () => {
78:     if (gameOver) return;
79:     // update ship based on input
80:     if (keys['ArrowLeft']) ship.angle -= ship.rotSpeed;
81:     if (keys['ArrowRight']) ship.angle += ship.rotSpeed;
82:     if (keys['ArrowUp'] && ship.fuel > 0) {
83:       ship.vx += Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.thrust;
84:       ship.vy -= Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.thrust;
85:       ship.fuel -= 0.05; // fuel consumption per frame while thrusting
86:     }
87:     // natural fuel drain
88:     ship.fuel = Math.max(0, ship.fuel - 0.01);
89:     // move ship
90:     ship.x += ship.vx;
91:     ship.y += ship.vy;
92:     // simple friction
93:     ship.vx *= 0.99;
94:     ship.vy *= 0.99;
95:     wrap(ship);
96: 
97:     // update asteroids
98:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
99:       a.x += a.speed;
100:       a.angle += a.rot;
101:       wrap(a);
102:     });
103: 
104:     // check collisions with asteroids
105:     for (const a of asteroids) {
106:       if (dist(ship.x, ship.y, a.x, a.y) < ship.radius + a.radius) {
107:         gameOver = true;
108:         alert('Game Over – You hit an asteroid!');
109:         return;
110:       }
111:     }
112: 
113:     // check fuel collection
114:     for (let i = fuels.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
115:       const f = fuels[i];
116:       if (dist(ship.x, ship.y, f.x, f.y) < ship.radius + f.radius) {
117:         ship.fuel = Math.min(ship.maxFuel, ship.fuel + f.value);
118:         fuels.splice(i, 1);
119:         // replenish fuel cell after a short delay
120:         setTimeout(addFuelCell, 2000);
121:       }
122:     }
123: 
124:     // lose condition – out of fuel
125:     if (ship.fuel <= 0) {
126:       gameOver = true;
127:       alert('Game Over – Out of fuel!');
128:       return;
129:     }
130: 
131:     // render
132:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
133:     // ship (triangle)
134:     ctx.save();
135:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
136:     ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
137:     ctx.beginPath();
138:     ctx.moveTo(0, -ship.radius);
139:     ctx.lineTo(ship.radius * 0.7, ship.radius);
140:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.radius * 0.7, ship.radius);
141:     ctx.closePath();
142:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
143:     ctx.fill();
144:     ctx.restore();
145:     // asteroids
146:     ctx.fillStyle = 'gray';
147:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
148:       ctx.save();
149:       ctx.translate(a.x, a.y);
150:       ctx.rotate(a.angle);
151:       ctx.beginPath();
152:       const spikes = 8;
153:       for (let i = 0; i < spikes; i++) {
154:         const theta = (i / spikes) * Math.PI * 2;
155:         const rad = i % 2 === 0 ? a.radius : a.radius * 0.6;
156:         ctx.lineTo(Math.cos(theta) * rad, Math.sin(theta) * rad);
157:       }
158:       ctx.closePath();
159:       ctx.fill();
160:       ctx.restore();
161:     });
162:     // fuel cells
163:     ctx.fillStyle = 'lime';
164:     fuels.forEach(f => {
165:       ctx.beginPath();
166:       ctx.arc(f.x, f.y, f.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
167:       ctx.fill();
168:     });
169:     // fuel gauge
170:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
171:     ctx.font = '14px sans-serif';
172:     ctx.fillText('Fuel: ' + Math.round(ship.fuel), 10, 20);
173: 
174:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
175:   };
176: 
177:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
178: })();
